name: Emelita
source:
Energetic young wizard that seems to be always interested into going new places. She is looking for the Reaper so that she could ask her something. Seems to know Will to some degree.

[spoiler]In chapter 5 it reveals that her full name is Ellenmelita and she is Rosanna's daughter.


Although in chapter 7, it's revealed that her real name is Millieda Ell Zilterry. She is the granddaughter of the last king and one of the two surviving legitimate heirs. After the last king and most of the royal family were killed during revolution, she and her older brother were saved and taken to Yuidora in lady Rosanna's care but the former disappeared during the bandits' attack on their caravan.[/spoiler]
